# The Yard Scout

> Honest, operator-tested buying guides and reviews for backyard wellness gear — hot tubs, saunas, and cold plunges. We focus on real specs, real prices, total cost of ownership, and the installation gotchas most retailers skip.

The Yard Scout publishes independent buying guides for backyard recovery equipment. Content is funded by affiliate links (see /affiliate-disclosure/) and produced under documented sourcing and review standards (see /editorial-standards/). Coverage spans inflatable and hard-sided hot tubs, barrel/cabin/infrared saunas, and DIY and commercial cold plunge setups.
